annotation.title_clean: ロボット介護機器開発のための安全ハンドブック
annotation.title_en: Safety Handbook for the Development of Robotic Care Devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AMED ロボット介護機器開発・導入促進事業 基準策定評価コンソーシアム (AIST, JARI, JNIOSH, JQA, JASPEC, Nagoya University)
annotation.venue: AMED Robotic Devices for Nursing Care Project
annotation.summary_en: Japanese handbook from the AMED nursing-care robot project consortium giving developers risk assessment methods, safety verification items and new safety test methods for eight categories of care robots (transfer, mobility, excretion, bathing, monitoring), built on ISO 12100 and ISO 13482 because no directly applicable standards exist.
key_provisions_or_claims: Developers follow ISO 12100 three-step risk reduction with a template risk assessment sheet (R=S×(F+Ps+A)).
ISO 13482 applied together with ISO 12100 and type-B standards, since no standard directly covers care robots.
Residual risk must be communicated to users; providing residual-risk documents does not exempt developers from product liability.
Provides injury thresholds (pain, fracture, fall) and new test methods for stability, durability, EMC and fall-sign detection.
Test methods are provisional and may be proposed for standardization.
